payload.name: Expat Savings Rates
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Choose a currency, account type and amount. See published rates from HSBC Expat, Standard Chartered Jersey, Skipton International, Barclays International and others, read from each bank's own page and dated. Accounts not open to your country of residence are removed. Each result shows the minimum deposit, who can open it and the compensation scheme that protects it. General information only, not personalised advice.
payload.longDescription:
选择一种货币、账户类型和金额。
直接从HSBC Expat、标准渣打银行泽西分行、Skipton International、巴克莱国际银行等银行官网页面获取并标注日期的公开利率。
不向您常住国家开放的账户将被移除。
每个结果会显示最低存款金额、可开户人群以及保障该账户的补偿计划。
仅提供一般性信息，不构成个性化建议。

payload.name: Harmonic (new)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
payload.longDescription:
利用Harmonic独有的数据，搜索、丰富并研究初创企业、公司和投资者，这些数据涵盖数百万家企业及其背后的人员。
获取包含融资信息、所在地、创始人及网络关系的详细公司档案。
通过自然语言查找符合特定条件的公司。
创建和管理公司及人员列表。
访问团队的网络图谱和保存的搜索记录。
更早发现初创企业，更快进行研究，并自信行动——一个内置AI的研究代理，无缝融入您的工作流程。

payload.name: VUHL VA Loan Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Veterans United Home Loans VA loan calculator helps Veterans and service members estimate their monthly mortgage payment. Enter details like home price, down payment, interest rate, loan term and military background, and it handles the rest, factoring in principal and interest, the VA funding fee, taxes and insurance. Whether you're buying a home or refinancing, it gives you a clear, complete payment picture without needing to know the fine print.

Calculator provided by Veterans United Home Loans. NMLS 1907 (www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org). Private Lender; Not endorsed or sponsored by the Dept. of Veterans Affairs or any government agency. Licensed in all 50 States. Equal Housing Opportunity.

Interest rates displayed in this calculator are shown for illustrative purposes only. Your rate may differ based on a variety of factors, including your credit score and the current market conditions. Taxes and Insurance amounts are estimates based on the loan amount.
payload.longDescription:
Veterans United Home Loans的VA贷款计算器帮助退伍军人和服务人员估算其每月抵押贷款还款额。输入房屋价格、首付、利率、贷款期限和军人背景等详细信息，其余内容将由计算器处理，包括本金和利息、VA资金费用、税费及保险。无论您是购买房屋还是再融资，都能在无需了解细则的情况下，为您提供清晰完整的还款概览。

本计算器由Veterans United Home Loans提供。NMLS 1907（www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org）。私人贷款机构，未得到退伍军人事务部或任何政府机构的赞助或认可。在全美50个州持牌经营。平等住房机会提供者。

本计算器显示的利率仅用于示例展示。您的实际利率可能因多种因素而有所不同，包括信用评分和当前市场状况。税费和保险金额是基于贷款金额的估算值。

payload.name: Creddy: Credit Card Rewards
payload.description: 信用卡权益、信用额度和积分
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Creddy helps you get more from the credit cards you have and choose the next one with care.

Ask which of your cards to use at a store or for a category, and Creddy ranks your cards by effective return: each card's earn rate multiplied by Creddy's estimate of what its points are worth. Ask what a card includes and Creddy shows its annual fee, earn rates, statement credits with when each one resets, lounge access, elite status, insurance and purchase protections, foreign transaction fee, and current welcome offer. Compare two or three cards side by side, get a short list of cards to consider for a spend category, no annual fee, or lounge access, and see where a points currency transfers, at what ratio, and which transfer bonuses are running now.

Card data comes from Creddy's reviewed catalog of US credit cards, built from each issuer's published terms and kept current by the Creddy team. Card names can be written the way people say them, such as "Amex Gold" or "CSR".

Limitations: Creddy covers US consumer and business credit cards only. It does not need an account, never asks for card numbers or login details, and cannot apply for cards, move points, or make purchases. Point values are estimates, and offers and terms can change, so confirm the details with the issuer before you apply. Some answers include links to issuer application pages, and Creddy may earn a commission if you apply.
payload.longDescription:
Creddy帮助您充分利用现有信用卡并谨慎选择下一张信用卡。

询问在商店或某个消费类别中使用哪张信用卡时，Creddy会根据实际回报率对信用卡进行排序：每张信用卡的积分返现率乘以Creddy对积分价值的估算。
询问某张信用卡的权益内容时，Creddy会显示年费、积分返现率、账单抵扣及其重置时间、休息室访问权限、高级会员资格、保险和购物保护、外币交易费以及当前的开卡礼遇。
将两张或三张信用卡并排对比，获取针对特定消费类别、无年费或休息室权限的候选卡清单，并查看积分货币的兑换比例、当前可兑换的积分奖励及兑换优惠。

信用卡数据来自Creddy经过审核的美国信用卡目录，该目录基于发卡机构公开条款建立，并由Creddy团队持续更新。
信用卡名称可使用人们常用的写法，例如「Amex Gold」或「CSR」。

限制条件：Creddy仅支持美国消费者和商务信用卡。
无需账户即可使用，不会要求输入卡号或登录信息，也无法申请信用卡、转移积分或进行购物。
积分价值为估算值，且优惠条款可能变动，请在申请前与发卡机构确认详细信息。
部分回答包含发卡机构申请页面链接，若通过这些链接申请，Creddy可能获得佣金。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Which of my cards to use for a purchase, Card earn rates by category, Statement credits and when they reset, Annual fees and first-year waivers, Lounge access, elite status and travel insurance, Purchase protection and foreign transaction fees, Current welcome offers, Compare two or three cards, Cards to consider for a spend category, No annual fee cards, Cards with airport lounge access, Points and miles transfer partners, Transfer ratios and transfer times, Transfer bonuses running now

payload.name: Trackstone
payload.description: 出租房产：价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out what your rented property is worth, or find one that already pays rent, without leaving the conversation.

Trackstone is a French real estate agency dedicated to rented properties: the property is sold with its tenant in place, and the lease simply continues with the new owner. The seller does not wait for the tenant to leave, and the buyer collects rent from day one.

What you can do:
- Value your rented apartment or house. Get a price range, the price per square meter and the gross yield your property offers a buyer, calculated from real comparable sales in your area (French public land registry, DVF), with a reliability score from 1 to 5.
- Browse rented properties for sale. Tell ChatGPT your city, your budget and the gross or net yield you are aiming for: Trackstone shows matching listings with photos, price, rent and both yields, sorted by the yield that matters to you.
- Read a city's market at a glance: price per square meter for apartments and houses, how prices have moved year after year, median rent and gross yield.

From any result, one click takes you to Trackstone to open the detailed estimate, view the listing or talk to an advisor about your sale.

Made for owners who want to sell a rented property in France, and for investors who want a property that earns rent from the first month.

Good to know: France only. Estimates cover apartments and houses; they are indicative, not formal appraisals, and less precise where few sales exist. Search results only include properties published publicly on Trackstone. No account is required, and the plugin never makes offers or transactions on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话界面，即可了解您的出租房产价值，或寻找已产生租金收益的房产。

Trackstone是一家法国房地产中介，专注出租房产交易：房产连同租客一并出售，租赁合同由新业主继续履行。卖方无需等待租客搬离，买方从成交第一天起即可收取租金。

您可以：
- 评估出租公寓或住宅价值
获取价格区间、每平方米价格及买家可获得的毛回报率，该数据基于您所在区域的真实成交案例（法国公共土地登记处DVF数据），并附带1到5分的可靠性评分。
- 浏览待售出租房产
告诉ChatGPT您的城市、预算以及目标毛回报率或净回报率：Trackstone将展示匹配房源，包含照片、价格、租金及两种回报率，按您关注的回报率排序。
- 快速了解城市市场情况：公寓和住宅的每平方米价格、历年价格变化趋势、中位租金及毛回报率。

在任何搜索结果页面，一键跳转至Trackstone查看详细估价、房源信息或联系顾问咨询出售事宜。

专为希望出售法国出租房产的业主，以及希望获得首月即可产生租金收益房产的投资者设计。

重要说明：仅适用于法国。
估价范围包括公寓和住宅；估价结果仅供参考，非正式评估报告，在成交案例较少的区域可能精度较低。
搜索结果仅包含Trackstone平台公开发布的房源。
无需账户即可使用，插件不会以您的名义进行任何报价或交易。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Estimate a rented property, Search rented properties for sale, Check city real estate prices

payload.name: Keel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keel turns your ideas into systematic strategies for Hyperliquid crypto perpetual futures (perps). Connect it to ChatGPT, describe a strategy, and ChatGPT builds it from Keel's strategy components, backtests it on real Hyperliquid history with fees and slippage, and explains the results.

With Keel in ChatGPT you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing

Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.

Keel in ChatGPT is for strategy research and backtesting. It does not place trades, submit orders, move funds or connect wallets — no order executes inside ChatGPT. What it writes is limited to your own Keel workspace: strategy drafts, backtest runs, notes and share links. Running a strategy with real capital is set up and approved by you in the Keel web app, outside ChatGPT. Backtests are simulations on historical data, not predictions or financial advice; trading perpetual futures carries a substantial risk of loss.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.
payload.longDescription:
Keel 将您的想法转化为适用于 Hyperliquid 加密货币永续期货（perps）的系统化策略。连接至 ChatGPT，描述策略，ChatGPT 将基于 Keel 的策略组件构建策略，使用手续费和滑点在真实 Hyperliquid 历史数据上进行回测，并解释结果。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Keel 可实现：
- 通过描述构建和编辑策略
- 进行回测并并排比较不同运行结果
- 从 Keel 库中已验证的策略开始
- 为策略添加备注并通过链接分享结果
- 查看您在 Keel 中运行的策略表现

您创建的所有内容都会保存在个人 Keel 工作区中。
除非您主动分享，否则内容不会公开。

ChatGPT 中的 Keel 仅用于策略研究和回测。
它不会执行交易、提交订单、转移资金或连接钱包——ChatGPT 内部不会执行任何订单。
其生成内容仅限于您的个人 Keel 工作区：策略草案、回测记录、备注和分享链接。
使用真实资金运行策略需在 Keel 网页应用中独立完成，且需您自行设置并确认。
回测基于历史数据模拟，非未来预测或金融建议；交易永续期货存在重大亏损风险。

Keel 会评估您设计的策略。
但不会提供投资建议或推荐，回测结果不预示未来收益。

payload.name: MortgageCompare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare two to four U.S. fixed-rate mortgage offers for the same loan amount using confirmed Loan Estimate figures. See payments, discount points, closing fees, lender credits, prepaid interest and mortgage insurance alongside financing cost over the time you expect to keep the loan. Change the holding period, inspect cost crossovers, principal repaid and remaining balances, and export your comparison. ChatGPT can help read Loan Estimates attached to your conversation; MortgageCompare receives structured financial figures, not the original documents. No live rate shopping, lender referrals, applications or approval decisions. The model supports fully amortizing loans, cash-paid fees and an explicit constant mortgage-insurance amount/duration. Confirm figures with your lenders.
payload.longDescription:
使用确认的贷款估算数据，比较2至4份相同贷款金额的美国固定利率抵押贷款报价。
显示还款金额、折扣点、结案费用、贷款人信用额度、预付利息和抵押贷款保险费用，以及您预计持有贷款期间的融资成本。
调整持有期限，查看成本交叉点、已还本金和剩余余额，并导出您的比较结果。
ChatGPT可帮助解读您对话中附加的贷款估算文件；MortgageCompare接收结构化财务数据，而非原始文件。
不提供实时利率比价、贷款机构推荐、申请或审批决策。
该模型支持全额摊销贷款、现金支付费用以及明确的固定抵押贷款保险金额/期限。
请与贷款机构确认数据准确性。

payload.name: Redbark
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Redbark connects your bank and brokerage accounts in Australia, New Zealand and the United States, and syncs them to Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, YNAB or a webhook.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can read the accounts you have connected to Redbark:
- Balances across all your accounts
- Transactions, with search by date, amount and description
- Spending summaries by category and merchant
- Brokerage holdings and trades
- The status of your syncs, with a diagnosis when one fails

It can also start a sync run on request, and give you a link to connect a new bank.

The plugin is read-only for your bank accounts. It cannot move money, make payments or place trades. It only sees accounts you have connected to your own Redbark account.

Requires a Redbark account.
payload.longDescription:
Redbark可连接澳大利亚、新西兰和美国的银行账户及经纪账户，并将数据同步至Google Sheets、Airtable、Notion、YNAB或网络钩子

通过此插件，ChatGPT可读取你已连接至Redbark的账户信息：
- 所有账户的余额情况
- 交易记录（支持按日期、金额、描述搜索）
- 按类别和商户统计的支出摘要
- 证券持仓及交易记录
- 同步状态显示，异常时提供诊断信息

插件支持按需启动数据同步，并提供连接新银行账户的指引链接

该插件仅对银行账户保持只读模式
无法执行资金转账、支付操作或下单交易
仅能访问你本人Redbark账户所连接的银行账户

需要拥有Redbark账户

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read account balances, Search transactions, Summarise spending, Read brokerage holdings, Check and run syncs, Connect a bank

payload.name: Finnce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your saved Finnce records to understand your portfolio and organize your investment research. With your permission, read saved portfolios, positions, purchases and sales; review watchlists and existing alerts; add an asset to a selected watchlist; and create or review thesis, contingency, review and checklist drafts. You choose the permitted data and actions in Finnce and can pause or revoke access there. Saved records may be incomplete and are not independently verified broker history. Drafts require your review. Finnce does not trade, move money, alter your purchases or sales, or guarantee returns. Creating new price alerts through this connection is currently unavailable. A Finnce account and a completed connection are required; installing the plugin alone does not authorize access.
payload.longDescription:
使用您保存的Finnce记录来了解您的投资组合并整理投资研究资料。
在获得您的授权后，可读取保存的投资组合、持仓、买入和卖出记录；查看关注列表和现有警报；将资产添加到选定的关注列表中；创建或查看投资逻辑、应急方案、复盘和检查清单草案。
您可以在Finnce中选择允许的数据和操作，并可随时暂停或撤销访问权限。
保存的记录可能不完整，且并非独立验证的经纪商历史记录。
草案需要您进行审核。
Finnce不进行交易、资金划转、修改您的买入或卖出操作，也不保证收益。
通过此连接创建新价格警报的功能目前暂不可用。
需要Finnce账户和完成连接；单独安装插件不会授予访问权限。

payload.name: Daffy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Daffy is a donor-advised fund: one account for all your giving. Add cash, stock, or crypto, get your tax deduction when you contribute, invest it to grow tax-free, and give to any of 1.5 million+ US charities whenever you're ready.

With Daffy in ChatGPT, your giving is one question away:

• Know where you stand. Ask for your balance, how much you can give right now, how your fund is invested, and how it has performed.
• See your giving history. Pull up donations by year or charity, review your contributions, and export a fund statement as CSV for tax time.
• Give in the moment. Say "give $100 to the local food bank" and Daffy recommends the donation from your fund to that charity. ChatGPT confirms the charity and amount before anything happens, and you can cancel a donation until it's paid out.
• Find the right charity. Search 1.5M+ US nonprofits by name or cause, or look one up by EIN, and get its mission, location, website, and Daffy profile.

Everything runs through your existing Daffy account with your normal login. Read-only questions never change anything, and no donation is ever made without your explicit approval.

You'll need a Daffy account (daffy.org). Available to Daffy members in the US.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search charities, Read fund activity, Export statements, Make donations, Cancel eligible donations

payload.name: Wealth Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wealth Tracker keeps your whole net worth in one place: cash and savings, investments, crypto, property, vehicles and other valuables, minus mortgages, loans and other debts. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your money in plain words and keep your records up to date from the conversation.

What you can do:
- See your net worth, totals, allocation and liquidity, how they have moved over time, and the income your holdings earned.
- Find any holding by name, ticker or ISIN, and list everything that is due or out of date for an update.
- Record a balance, a buy or sell you have already made, interest or a fee, or a whole account statement or screenshot at once. Every change can be previewed first, returns a receipt, and can be undone within 30 days.
- Choose how often Wealth Tracker reminds you to update an account or a holding.
- If you have connected a bank in the Wealth Tracker app: see spending and income by category, merchant and period, search your transactions, review subscriptions and other recurring payments, recategorise transactions, and mark a recurring payment as confirmed, dismissed or cancelled in your records.

What it does not do:
- It never moves money, makes payments or places trades. Buys and sells are records of trades you made elsewhere.
- Bank data is read-only. It cannot connect a bank, sign in to your bank or broker, or change anything at your bank or at a merchant. Bank connections are set up in the Wealth Tracker app.
- It reads and changes only the signed-in user's own Wealth Tracker records, and sees nothing you have not added to Wealth Tracker.
- It reports your own figures and does not give investment, tax or financial advice.

You need a Wealth Tracker account and sign in with it when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Wealth Tracker将您的全部净资产集中管理：包括现金和储蓄、投资、加密货币、房产、车辆及其他贵重物品，扣除抵押贷款、贷款及其他债务。
连接到ChatGPT即可用通俗语言询问您的财务状况，并通过对话保持记录更新。

您可以：
- 查看净资产、总金额、资产配置和流动性，以及它们随时间的变化情况，还有持仓产生的收入。
- 通过名称、代码或ISIN编号查找任何持仓，并列出所有需要更新的到期或过期项目。
- 一次性记录余额、已发生的买卖交易、利息或费用，或整份账户报表或截图。
每次更改均可先预览，生成收据，并可在30天内撤销。
- 自定义Wealth Tracker提醒您更新账户或持仓的频率。
- 如果已在Wealth Tracker应用中连接银行：可按类别、商家和周期查看收支情况，搜索交易记录，审查订阅及其他定期付款，重新分类交易，并在记录中将定期付款标记为已确认、已忽略或已取消。

它无法实现以下功能：
- 永不移动资金、发起付款或下单交易。
买卖操作仅记录您在其他平台完成的交易。
- 银行数据为只读模式。
无法连接银行、登录您的银行或券商，或在银行或商家端进行任何修改。
银行连接需在Wealth Tracker应用中设置。
- 仅读取和修改已登录用户自身的Wealth Tracker记录，不会查看您未添加到Wealth Tracker的信息。
- 仅报告您输入的数据，不提供投资、税务或财务建议。

您需要拥有Wealth Tracker账户，并在连接时使用该账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read net worth, allocation and holdings, Read net worth history and income earned, List holdings that need an update, Record balances, trades, income and fees, Sync an account statement or screenshot, Undo a change within 30 days, Set update reminder periods, Read spending, transactions and subscriptions from connected banks, Categorise bank transactions

payload.name: StockViz Mutual Funds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore StockViz mutual fund model portfolios and ask research questions about strategies and historical index metrics through its authenticated MCP server. Separate broker integrations are needed for trade execution.
payload.longDescription: 通过经过认证的MCP服务器，探索StockViz共同基金模型组合，并针对策略和历史指数指标提出研究问题。交易执行需要单独的经纪商集成。

payload.name: Open Natural Gas
payload.description: 比较乔治亚州天然气费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Open Natural Gas helps Georgia residents compare residential natural gas prices and estimated annual bills using Georgia Public Service Commission filings. It can compare current plan costs for a household's annual therm usage, show factual information about a Georgia gas marketer, and summarize historical rate movements. payload.name: StockPortfolio.pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StockPortfolio.pro gives ChatGPT read-only research on US-listed public companies, built from the filings those companies submit to the SEC.

Ask about a company's revenue, profit, margins, earnings per share, share count, cash flow, debt or stock-based compensation and get the reported history back, with each value carrying the fiscal period it belongs to and the filing it came from. Search SEC filings by form type and date, read the section of a filing that answers a question, compare two to five companies on the same metrics, or see the arithmetic behind a period-over-period change, including how much of an earnings-per-share move came from net income and how much from share count.

Every figure is reported data with a source. A value a company did not report is returned as missing with a note explaining why, never estimated. Derived figures are labelled with the metrics they were derived from. Companies whose fiscal years end on different dates are flagged rather than blended into a single comparison.

Use it for equity and credit research, checking what a company actually disclosed, preparing for an earnings date, building comparables, and tracing a number back to the filing that states it.

Limitations: US-listed companies only. The plugin is read-only, with no trading, no brokerage access and no portfolio or account changes. Nothing it returns is investment advice or a recommendation. Filing text is returned as excerpts rather than whole documents. Data follows the SEC filing calendar rather than real time, so a document filed today may take until the next index refresh to appear.
payload.longDescription:
StockPortfolio.pro 为 ChatGPT 提供对在美国上市的公众公司的只读研究，这些信息源自公司向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的文件。

可查询公司的营收、利润、毛利率、每股收益、股份数量、现金流、债务或股票薪酬，并获取已报告的历史数据，每个数值都会标注所属的财季及原始文件来源。可按文件类型和日期搜索SEC文件，阅读解答问题的文件章节，对比2-5家公司的相同指标，或查看期间对比变化的计算细节，包括每股收益变动中来自净利润的部分和来自股份数量的部分。

所有数据均为带来源标注的报告数值。若公司未披露某项数据则返回缺失状态并说明原因，绝不进行估算。衍生数值会标注其计算依据的指标。财务年度结束日期不同的公司会特别标记，而非强行合并比较。

可用于股权和信用研究、验证公司实际披露内容、准备财报日、构建可比公司分析，并追溯数值对应的原始文件记录。

限制条件：仅限在美国上市的公司。插件为只读模式，不支持交易、无经纪账户访问权限，也不允许修改投资组合或账户信息。返回内容不构成投资建议或推荐。文件内容仅以摘要形式返回，而非完整文档。数据遵循SEC文件提交日历，而非实时更新，今日提交的文件可能需等到下次索引更新后才能显示。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Dinzo
payload.description: 面向巴西的个人财务管理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dinzo is a personal finance app for people in Brazil. It brings together bank accounts and credit cards connected through Brazil's Open Finance, manual entries, credit card bills, goals, recurring expenses and investments.

With the Dinzo plugin, ChatGPT can answer questions about the user's own Dinzo data, such as how much they spent on a category, which credit card bills are open and when they are due, or what their balance will be at the end of the month. With the read and write permission, ChatGPT can also create, edit, categorize and delete entries in the user's Dinzo account, always after the user confirms.

Dinzo never moves money: it does not make payments, transfers or investments, it never sees bank passwords, and it cannot connect banks. Recording a bill payment only marks it in the user's Dinzo records.

Requires an existing Dinzo account. Dinzo's app and data are in Portuguese; ChatGPT answers in the user's language.
payload.longDescription:
Dinzo是面向巴西用户的个人财务管理应用。该应用整合通过巴西开放金融连接的银行账户和信用卡、手动输入、信用卡账单、目标、定期支出和投资。

通过Dinzo插件，ChatGPT可以回答用户关于其Dinzo数据的问题，例如某类支出金额、未结信用卡账单及到期时间，或月底余额情况。在获得用户确认后，ChatGPT可通过读写权限在用户Dinzo账户中创建、编辑、分类和删除记录。

Dinzo从不处理资金：它不执行支付、转账或投资操作，不会查看银行密码，也无法连接银行账户。记录账单支付仅会在用户Dinzo记录中进行标记。

需要现有的Dinzo账户。Dinzo应用和数据使用葡萄牙语；ChatGPT以用户语言进行回答。

payload.name: akta.pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
akta.pro provides private company data, news and signals for AI agents like ChatGPT to find and enrich companies, monitor company events, and track developments across industries and market themes.

1. Find companies with filters: Build company lists, market maps, target accounts and peer sets using industry, location, ownership, funding, investors, revenue, valuation and more.
2. Enrich companies and build profiles: Access data on 20M+ companies across 74 structured fields, covering firmographics, management, products, funding, transactions, revenue, valuation, technology and more.

Requires an akta.pro account.
payload.longDescription:
akta.pro为像ChatGPT这样的AI代理提供私营公司数据、新闻和信号，帮助其发现并丰富公司信息，监控公司事件，追踪各行业和市场主题的发展动态。

1. 通过筛选条件查找公司：根据行业、地点、所有权、融资、投资者、营收、估值等维度构建公司列表、市场图谱、目标客户和竞品集合。
2. 丰富公司信息并建立档案：访问覆盖74个结构化字段的2000多万家公司数据，包含企业属性、管理层、产品、融资、交易、营收、估值、技术等信息。
3. 监控公司新闻、信号和事件：跟踪2000多万家公司的77种事件类型，包括融资、并购、合作、产品发布、高管变动、招聘、裁员、诉讼等重大动态。

5. 分析另类信号：追踪员工规模、网站流量、招聘启事、社交动态、员工评价和产品评价，所有数据均与统一公司ID关联。

需要akta.pro账户。

payload.name: Yield Clarity
payload.description: 你的财务计划在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yield Clarity tracks your investments, cash, pensions, property and spending, and forecasts when you could reach financial independence.

Connect your Yield Clarity account to ask about your plan in ChatGPT:

- Net worth, holdings and planned spending, in your plan's currency
- Your projected financial independence date, retirement outlook and year-by-year forecast
- What-ifs, such as saving more each month, retiring on a different date, a different return or a one-off cost, compared with your current plan. Nothing is saved.
- Monte Carlo simulations: the chance of reaching financial independence by your target date and of your money lasting through retirement
- Portfolio history and the effect of your saved decisions

The connection is read-only: ChatGPT can't add, change or delete anything in your Yield Clarity account. Figures come from Yield Clarity's own calculations, so they match the app. Forecasts are estimates based on your own assumptions, not financial advice.

Requires a Yield Clarity account with AI assistant access. You can disconnect at any time in Yield Clarity under Settings, AI assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Yield Clarity跟踪您的投资、现金、养老金、房产和支出，并预测您可能实现财务自由的时间。

将您的Yield Clarity账户连接至ChatGPT，以询问您的计划：

- 以您计划货币显示的净资产、持仓和支出计划
- 您预计的财务自由日期、退休前景及逐年预测
- 情景模拟，例如每月增加储蓄、更换退休日期、不同收益率或一次性支出成本，与当前计划的对比
不会保存任何数据
- 蒙特卡洛模拟：在目标日期前实现财务自由的可能性，以及资金在退休期间持续性的概率
- 投资组合历史及您保存决策的影响

该连接为只读模式：ChatGPT无法在您的Yield Clarity账户中添加、修改或删除任何内容。
数据来源于Yield Clarity自身的计算，因此与App内数据一致。
预测结果基于您提供的假设条件，仅供参考，不构成财务建议。

需要拥有具备AI助手权限的Yield Clarity账户。
您可在Yield Clarity的「设置」-「AI助手」中随时断开连接。

payload.name: Earnings Feed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research public SEC records with Earnings Feed. Look up a company by ticker or CIK; list recent filings by filer and form type; find filings by company name or ticker; inspect a filing's metadata and document list; and review disclosed insider transactions. Results include filing accessions and links to SEC sources and Earnings Feed.

Filing search matches filer company names or tickers, not the text inside filings. Filing detail returns metadata and document names, not document text or quoted passages. Ownership filings can have different filers and issuers. Insider acquisition and disposition filters include awards, gifts and other transaction types, not just open-market purchases and sales. Results reflect the records available when requested.

Connect an existing Earnings Feed account through OAuth. Requests use that account's API allowance. This plugin provides research information and does not execute trades, manage subscriptions or create filing alerts.
payload.longDescription:
通过Earnings Feed研究公开的SEC记录。通过股票代码或CIK查找公司；按申报方和文件类型列出最近的文件；通过公司名称或股票代码查找文件；检查文件的元数据和文档列表；查看披露的内部人员交易。结果包含文件接入编号以及到SEC来源和Earnings Feed的链接。

文件搜索仅匹配申报公司名称或股票代码，而非文件内的文本内容。文件详情仅返回元数据和文档名称，而非文档正文或引用内容。所有权文件可能包含不同的申报方和发行人。内部人员买入和卖出过滤器包含奖励、赠与和其他交易类型，而不仅仅是场内买卖。结果反映请求时可用的记录。

通过OAuth连接现有Earnings Feed账户。请求将使用该账户的API配额。此插件提供研究信息，不执行交易、管理订阅或创建文件警报。

payload.name: Kryptos
payload.description: 加密货币组合、税务及账簿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kryptos brings your crypto portfolio, transaction history, tax figures and accounting ledger into ChatGPT, across 5,000+ exchanges, wallets and blockchains.

Ask what you hold and what it is worth, search your transaction history by asset, wallet, label or date, review DeFi positions and NFT collections, and look at the ledger detail behind any trade.

Kryptos also finds the data problems that make crypto tax wrong — missing prices, missing cost basis, sells with no matching purchase, balances that disagree with the ledger, wallets you never connected — and lets you fix them in the same conversation: recategorise a transaction, correct a price, merge a transfer that detection missed, or add a trade that never made it into an export.

Finance teams can map transactions to a chart of accounts, apply categorisation rules, generate double-entry journals and push them to Xero, QuickBooks or Softledger.

You sign in to Kryptos with OAuth and grant access to one workspace. Kryptos never asks for exchange API keys or wallet private keys in the conversation. It reads and records only — no tool can send, swap, withdraw, deposit or trade any asset.

Requires a Kryptos account.
payload.longDescription:
Kryptos将您的加密货币组合、交易记录、税务数据和会计分录整合到ChatGPT中，覆盖5000多个交易所、钱包和区块链。

您可以询问自己持有哪些资产及其价值，按资产、钱包、标签或日期搜索交易记录，查看DeFi持仓和NFT收藏，查阅任何交易背后的分录明细。

Kryptos还能发现导致加密货币税务错误的数据问题——缺失的价格、缺失的成本基础、无对应买入记录的卖出、与分录不一致的余额、未连接的钱包——并在同一对话中允许您进行修正：重新分类交易、更正价格、合并检测遗漏的转账，或添加未导出的交易。

财务团队可将交易映射到会计科目表，应用分类规则，生成复式记账凭证并推送到Xero、QuickBooks或Softledger。

您可通过OAuth登录Kryptos并授权一个工作区访问权限。
Kryptos在对话中从不请求交易所API密钥或钱包私钥。
它仅执行读取和记录操作——任何工具都无法发送、交换、提现、存款或交易任何资产。

需要Kryptos账户。

payload.name: Jemma
payload.description: 护士薪资与实际到手收入计算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jemma answers nurse pay questions with real math. Ask what you'll take home at your hourly rate, what a travel contract is worth after tax, whether a 1099 or locums rate beats a staff job, what you'd need to earn to move cities, or what nurses with your credential earn in your state. Every figure comes from Jemma's calculators, using 2026 federal and state tax tables, and pay benchmarks come from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, always labeled. Where enough nurses have verified their pay on Jemma, you see Jemma's median too, and where they haven't, you see how close that group is to the 30 nurses Jemma needs to publish it. No account needed, and Jemma never asks for your license number or your salary inside ChatGPT. Estimates, not tax advice.
payload.longDescription: Jemma通过真实数学计算解答护士薪资问题。您可询问在时薪下实际到手收入、外派合同税后价值、1099模式或临时护士费率是否优于正式岗位、换城市工作需达到的收入水平，以及与您资质相符的护士在本州的平均薪资。所有数据均来自Jemma的计算器，采用2026年联邦及各州税务表格，薪资基准数据来自美国劳工统计局（BLS），且均会标注来源。当足够多护士在Jemma上验证过薪资数据时，您将看到Jemma的中位数统计；若数据不足，则会显示该群体与Jemma要求的30名护士样本的接近程度。无需账户即可使用，Jemma在ChatGPT内不会索取您的执照号码或薪资信息。以上内容为估算结果，不构成税务建议。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MoveSurge is a real-time market news tape for US equities and cross-asset macro that measures what each event did to the price. For eligible headlines it records the instrument price immediately before the headline was published, one minute after and ten minutes after, plus volume against its usual level for that window, so each move is tied to the event that caused it.

With this plugin you can:
- Ask why something suddenly moved. MoveSurge detects abnormal moves in oil, index futures, currencies and stocks, investigates them, and publishes the cause it found with the evidence, a confidence level and how the move followed through.
- Check earnings: EPS and revenue against the consensus estimate, beat or miss, guidance direction and the stock's measured reaction to the release, plus who reports next.
- Check economic data: CPI, payrolls, PMIs and central-bank decisions with actual, forecast and previous, the surprise, and what markets did in the minutes after the print, plus the releases scheduled ahead.
- Follow President Trump's Truth Social posts as they cross the tape, with the measured reaction where a post moved an instrument.
- Search the tape by topic or ticker, rank the events with the largest measured moves in a window, or pull a ticker's recent catalysts with the price path on each.
- Read explainer articles in full with their sources.

The coverage_stats tool reports live counts of events, measured reactions and tickers covered, so the figures can be checked.

Read-only: the tools do not write, trade or place orders, and the results are not investment advice.

payload.name: MLS Colombia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MLS Colombia answers two common questions about the Colombian property market inside ChatGPT with no account needed.

How much is my house worth?
Tell ChatGPT the municipality or city, whether it is a house (casa) or an apartment (apartamento) and the built area in square meters (plus the lot for a house). You get an indicative sale range in Colombian pesos (low, mid and high), an approximate US dollar figure at the dated TRM exchange rate, a confidence label (alta, media or baja) and, when available, the expected monthly rent. It is an informal estimate: useful to orient yourself before talking to an advisor, not a substitute for a certified commercial appraisal.

Real estate agencies in your city
Ask for inmobiliarias in Bogotá, Medellín, Cali or any other city and get some public directory entries from MLS Colombia, each with a link to its profile. Entries are public and are not endorsements; each firm can claim and confirm its profile.

How it works
The plugin is read-only: it does not post, send messages or change anything. It does not ask for your name, email or phone, and it does not store your queries. Answers appear as a card in the conversation and as plain text, so they work on any screen. If you want to continue, you can ask an advisor for a valuation; that step happens outside ChatGPT, at mlscolombia.co/valorar, and you decide whether to leave your details.

What it does not do
It does not value land or fincas, does not issue a certified appraisal and does not give legal, tax or financial advice.

Examples: "How much is my 120 m2 house in Rionegro worth?", "Estimate a 70 m2 apartment in Medellín", "Real estate agencies in Bogotá", "Inmobiliarias in Cartagena".

Support: https://mlscolombia.co/soporte/

payload.name: QuarterWise 1099 Tax Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A self employment tax calculator and quarterly estimated tax planner for 2026. Tell QuarterWise 1099 Tax Planner your 1099 or freelance income, business expenses, and filing status, and it works through the IRS 2026 Form 1040-ES worksheets: self-employment tax on 92.35% of net profit (12.4% Social Security up to the 184,500 dollar wage base, 2.9% Medicare, and the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax), the deductible half of SE tax, the 20% qualified business income (QBI) deduction, and federal income tax with the 2026 brackets and standard deduction.

It answers questions like "I made 60k on 1099, how much do I owe", "how much should I pay in quarterly taxes", and "how much to set aside for taxes as a freelancer". It handles a W-2 job plus a side gig (wages use up the Social Security wage base and paycheck withholding is subtracted), married couples where one or both spouses are self-employed, business losses, the child tax credit, and the new 2026 senior and charitable deductions.

For quarterly estimated taxes it compares 90% of your 2026 tax with 100% of your 2025 tax (110% if your 2025 AGI was over 150,000 dollars), applies the 1,000 dollar rule, and gives the amount for each due date: Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, 2026 and Jan 15, 2027. Missed a payment? Add what you have paid and it shows what to pay now and at each remaining date.

The result appears as a card in the chat: a waterfall from income through deductions to tax, and four quarterly payment cards with dates, amounts, and status. Download a calendar file (.ics) with reminders before each due date and a printable PDF worksheet laid out like the IRS worksheet, with a payment record.

Good for freelancers, independent contractors, gig workers (DoorDash, Uber, Instacart, Etsy), consultants, and anyone with 1099-NEC or 1099-K income.

Limitations: estimates for planning only, not tax advice. Federal tax for tax year 2026 only; state income tax is not calculated (it tells you if your state has none). Capital gains rates, AMT, net investment income tax, the earned income credit, penalty amounts, and the annualized installment method are not included. Above the 2026 QBI threshold it applies the phase-in using W-2 wages your business paid, with property basis treated as zero. It does not file returns or make payments.
payload.longDescription:
2026年度自雇税计算器和季度预估税务计划器。向QuarterWise 1099税务规划器提供您的1099收入或自由职业收入、业务支出和申报状态，它将通过IRS 2026年1040-ES表格工作表进行计算：基于净收益92.35%的自雇税（其中12.4%社会保障税上限为184,500美元工资基数，2.9%医疗保险税，以及0.9%附加医疗保险税），自雇税可抵扣的一半金额，20%合格业务收入（QBI）扣除额，以及按照2026年税率级距和标准扣除额计算的联邦所得税。

它可以解答诸如「我在1099收入中赚了6万美元，需要缴纳多少税？」、「季度税款应缴纳多少？」以及「作为自由职业者应预留多少税款？」等问题。支持处理包含W-2工作和副业的情况（工资会消耗社会保障工资基数且工资税扣除会减少），夫妻共同申报中一方或双方为自雇人士的情况，业务亏损，儿童税收抵免，以及2026年新的老年和慈善扣除额。

在计算季度预估税款时，它会比较2026年税款的90%与2025年税款的100%（若2025年应税收入超过150,000美元则为110%），应用1,000美元规则，并给出每个缴税日期的金额：2026年4月15日、6月15日、9月15日以及2027年1月15日。错过付款？输入已支付金额，它会显示当前需支付金额及剩余日期的应缴金额。

结果将以聊天界面中的卡片形式呈现：从收入经过扣除项到税款的瀑布流视图，以及包含日期、金额和状态的四张季度付款卡片。可下载包含每个缴税日期提醒的日历文件（.ics格式）和可打印的PDF表格（布局与IRS表格相同，并附有付款记录）。

适用于自由职业者、独立承包商、零工工作者（DoorDash、Uber、Instacart、Etsy）、顾问，以及所有拥有1099-NEC或1099-K收入的人士。

限制条件：仅用于规划估算，不构成税务建议。仅计算2026年度联邦税，不包含州所得税（会提示您的州是否无州所得税）。不包含资本利得税率、替代最低税（AMT）、净投资收入税、工薪抵税额、罚款金额以及年度分摊支付法。超过2026年QBI门槛时，将使用企业支付的W-2工资进行逐步调整，资产基础视为零。不处理税务申报或实际缴款。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PocketBuddy answers questions about your spending, budgets and net worth with your own numbers instead of averages.

Ask why you spent more this month than last, what you pay for every month, how your net worth has changed, or how your budgets and goals are doing. PocketBuddy works it out from your accounts and shows it beside the conversation. You can look around before connecting anything. A sample household shows what an answer looks like, and two calculators work from numbers you type in: how much you would need to stop working at a given spending level, and how your retirement savings compare for your age.

When you connect, PocketBuddy returns the balances, totals and transactions needed for your question, including merchant names. Its account tool can also return your account ID, name and email. It never returns bank logins, account numbers or access tokens. You can disconnect at any time in PocketBuddy's settings.
payload.longDescription:

PocketBuddy会从您的账户中分析并显示结果，紧随对话之后。
每个回答都会注明覆盖的日期范围、包含的账户数量、更新时间以及未包含的内容，例如账户间的资金划转。

在连接任何账户前您可以先进行浏览。
示例家庭账户展示了一个回答的样式，同时两个计算器可基于您输入的数字运行：在特定消费水平下您需要积累多少资金才能停止工作，以及您的退休储蓄与同龄人相比如何。

PocketBuddy仅用于数据读取，不会执行操作。
它无法转移资金、支付账单、进行交易或修改银行连接。
如果您在连接时选择允许更改，它可以重新分类交易或添加您现金支付的交易记录。
每次修改都会先展示给您确认，仅在获得批准后执行，并且可以撤销。

PocketBuddy仅提供数据，不提供财务建议。
购买检查功能会展示包含该笔消费的月份情况，最终决策仍由您自行做出。

连接后，PocketBuddy会返回回答问题所需的资金余额、总金额和交易记录，包括商户名称。

payload.name: COROS

payload.name: Fitness AI Connector
payload.description: 基于 Garmin 数据的 AI 教练
payload.summaryOriginal: AI coach for your Garmin data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Garmin wearable to get personalized health insights and AI coaching. Track daily wellness metrics including steps, heart rate, sleep quality, stress, and HRV. Analyze workouts with pace breakdown, lap splits, heart rate drift, and opt-in time-series data. payload.name: Tredict
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tredict is a platform for endurance training planning, structured workouts, and workout analysis for athletes and coaches.

Create reusable training plans and structured workouts for running, cycling, swimming, and other sports directly in Tredict with ChatGPT. Plans can be tailored to your recent activities and preferred training approach, whether based on power, pace, or other performance metrics.

Execute your training plan directly on your sports watch through Tredict’s integrations with Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Wahoo, Coros, and other platforms.

Organize your training calendar with AI-powered assistance that helps summarize workouts and suggest meaningful titles and descriptions for your training sessions.

Analyze past training activities and generate structured workout plans that support long-term endurance training.

Tredict integrates with ChatGPT to help athletes and coaches organize and plan endurance training more efficiently.

Tredict is GDPR compliant.
payload.longDescription:
Tredict 是面向运动员和教练的耐力训练规划、结构化训练和训练分析平台。

通过 ChatGPT，你可以直接在 Tredict 中创建可重复使用的训练计划和结构化训练课程，适用于跑步、骑行、游泳及其他运动。计划可根据你近期的活动和偏好的训练方法进行定制，例如依据功率、配速或其他表现指标。

通过 Tredict 与 Garmin、Suunto、Polar、Wahoo、Coros 等平台的集成，可直接在运动手表上执行训练计划。

借助 AI 助手整理训练日历，汇总训练内容，并为训练课程建议恰当的标题和说明。

分析过往训练活动，并生成支持长期耐力训练的结构化训练计划。

Tredict 集成了 ChatGPT，帮助运动员和教练更高效地组织和规划耐力训练。

Tredict 符合 GDPR 要求。

payload.name: freddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: freddy connects the health and fitness data you already track (wearables, rings, CGMs, sleep trackers, and training platforms) and makes it available to ChatGPT. Ask about your sleep, recovery, training load, heart rate, steps, or workouts and get answers grounded in your own history. Connect a source once and freddy keeps it in sync and normalizes it across devices, so every conversation can draw on your real data. Your data stays private: it is accessible only to you, revocable at any time, and never sold or used for advertising.
payload.longDescription: freddy 可将你已经追踪的健康和健身数据（可穿戴设备、智能戒指、CGM 连续血糖监测仪、睡眠追踪器和训练平台）连接起来，并提供给 ChatGPT 使用。你可以询问睡眠、恢复情况、训练负荷、心率、步数或锻炼，回答会基于你的个人历史数据。连接数据来源后，freddy 会持续同步并统一不同设备的数据格式，让每次对话都可以依据真实数据作答。你的数据会保持私密：只有你能访问，可随时撤销访问权限，绝不会出售或用于广告。

payload.name: Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calorie Tracker AI helps you log meals, track calories, and understand your eating habits with minimal effort. Simply enter what you eat, and the app estimates calories and nutrients so you can stay aware of your daily intake without manual calculations.
payload.longDescription: Calorie Tracker AI 帮助你轻松记录餐食、追踪卡路里并了解饮食习惯。只需输入吃了什么，应用就会估算卡路里和营养素，让你无需手动计算也能了解每日摄入量。

payload.name: LiftTrack
payload.description: 适用于 Garmin 的举重训练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.
payload.longDescription:

规划本周训练——询问“我上周练了什么？”或“我的推举训练模板里有什么？”，即可根据真实训练和模板获取回答，让 ChatGPT 建议下一步安排。

坚持计划——让 ChatGPT 提醒你某项训练的内容、上次使用的重量和组数，或今天应该完成什么。

回顾并调整——按周或按月询问总结（“我练了几次？”“我的深蹲进步如何？”），并据此调整训练量或强度。

payload.name: FitAI Pro
payload.description: 制定训练计划并记录组数

有 AI 助手一路提醒和陪伴，让你保持节奏并养成持久习惯。

payload.name: Face Yoga

payload.longDescription: Calorie Tracker Guide 帮助你根据具体需求找到理想的卡路里追踪器。我们已人工评测、测试并验证 120 多款应用，并为其功能评分，确保提供尽可能好的建议。根据你的个人目标、经验水平和具体要求，为你推荐合适的应用。

payload.name: Trash Panda - Food Scanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trash Panda makes it easier to choose food that supports your health goals. Look up grocery products by name or barcode to see what’s really inside. Get clear explanations of additives, hidden sugars, and ultra-processed ingredients — all in plain language.

Understand how ingredients are rated and grouped as potentially harmful, questionable, bioengineered or added sugar. Learn what each ingredient is, why it's used, and the health impacts. Whether you’re comparing products or looking for a better swap, Trash Panda helps you move from confusion to confident choices.

Simple. Fast. Built for everyday grocery decisions.
payload.longDescription:
Trash Panda 帮助你更轻松地选择符合健康目标的食品。按名称或条形码查询杂货商品，了解其真实成分。它会用通俗易懂的语言解释添加剂、隐藏糖分和超加工成分。

了解成分如何评级，以及哪些成分被归为可能有害、存在争议、生物工程来源或添加糖。了解每种成分是什么、为何使用以及可能产生的健康影响。无论你是在比较产品，还是寻找更好的替代品，Trash Panda 都能帮助你消除困惑，做出更有把握的选择。

payload.name: BODi
payload.description: 找到最适合你的锻炼计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BODi, formerly Beachbody, is a fitness platform with over 140 guided fitness programs and over 8,000 workouts you can do anytime, with or without equipment. Follow well-known programs like P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, #mbf Muscle Burns Fat, and DIG DEEPER, led by trainers including Shaun T, Autumn Calabrese, Megan Davies, and Jennifer Jacobs.

BODi for ChatGPT helps you find the workout plan that fits you. Describe what you’re looking for in everyday language and get clear guidance to choose a plan you can stick with.
payload.longDescription:
BODi 前身为 Beachbody，是健身平台，拥有超过 140 套指导式健身计划和超过 8,000 项锻炼，你可以随时进行，无论有无器材。跟随 P90X、Insanity、21 Day Fix、#mbf Muscle Burns Fat 和 DIG DEEPER 等知名计划，由 Shaun T、Autumn Calabrese、Megan Davies 和 Jennifer Jacobs 等教练指导。

BODi for ChatGPT 帮助你找到适合的锻炼计划。用日常语言描述需求，获取清晰指导，选择能坚持下去的计划。

payload.name: Pearl Pet Care
payload.description: 经兽医验证的宠物答疑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pet owners often have questions about their animal’s health, diet, or behavior but don’t have immediate access to a veterinarian.

Pearl provides AI-generated answers that are reviewed by licensed veterinarians. Each response is clearly marked by the veterinarian as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional veterinary care.

Users can:
- Ask questions about pet health, nutrition, and behavior
- See whether a veterinarian marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get guidance in the moment when an in-person veterinarian is unavailable
payload.longDescription:
宠物主人经常会对动物的健康、饮食或行为有疑问，但无法立即联系到兽医。

Pearl 提供由持证兽医审核的 AI 生成答案。兽医会明确标记每条回答为正确或不正确，让用户迅速判断信息是否可信。

此应用仅提供信息参考，不可替代专业兽医护理。

用户可以：
- 询问宠物健康、营养和行为方面的问题
- 查看兽医是否将 AI 回答标记为正确或不正确
- 在无法联系到现场兽医时及时获得指导

payload.name: NyquistAI
payload.description: 最新 FDA 医疗器械信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.

payload.name: Achieve Harmony

payload.name: Flow State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flow State connects ChatGPT to an endurance athlete's training calendar. Users can review upcoming workouts, inspect athlete profile and recovery context, create or update workouts and races, manage training plans, analyze training load and workout history, and sync selected workouts to Garmin when their Flow State account has Garmin connected.
payload.longDescription: Flow State 将 ChatGPT 连接到耐力运动员的训练日历。用户可以查看即将进行的训练，了解运动员档案和恢复情况，创建或更新训练和比赛，管理训练计划，分析训练负荷和训练历史；如果 Flow State 账户已连接 Garmin，还可以将选定训练同步到 Garmin。

payload.name: InnoSupps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse and find Inno Supps supplements based on your goals — energy, sleep, digestion, or workout support. Answer a few questions and get tailored product suggestions from the Inno Supps catalog, with details on ingredients and formulations to help you choose.
payload.longDescription: 根据你的目标——精力、睡眠、消化或锻炼支持——浏览并查找 Inno Supps 补充剂。回答几个问题，即可从 Inno Supps 产品目录中获得个性化商品建议，以及成分和配方详情，帮助你做出选择。

payload.name: Purely Snacks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Purely Snacks helps you find healthier snack options that match your preferences. Search for products by type, ingredient, nutrition goal, or dietary attribute, then refine results with requests like “lower sugar,” “more protein,” “gluten free,” “vegan,” or “no peanuts.”

The app returns snack options with useful details such as brand, calories, protein, sugar, ingredients, dietary attributes, product categories, and tradeoffs, helping you compare choices quickly before opening the product page.
payload.longDescription:
Purely Snacks 可帮助你根据偏好寻找更健康的零食。你可以按类型、成分、营养目标或饮食属性搜索商品，然后用“少糖”“更多蛋白质”“无麸质”“纯素”或“不含花生”等要求进一步筛选结果。

payload.longDescription: WeightWatchers 应用帮助使用 GLP-1 药物的人士寻找符合自身生活方式的膳食灵感。通过将 ChatGPT 连接到 WeightWatchers 食谱库，用户可以轻松、无压力地发现营养丰富且令人满足的食谱。用户无需在海量选项中搜索，即可获得以 WeightWatchers 可信指导为依据的膳食和食谱建议，从而更有信心地安排日常饮食。如需更多支持，该应用还可便捷地连接注册营养师，让用户从实用的膳食灵感顺畅过渡到个性化营养指导。

payload.name: DREAMHALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.
payload.longDescription:
你已经拥有自己的生活。打造你想要的生活。

DREAMHALL 是一个私密、有结构的自我关怀工作区，帮助你思考那些答案应由自己决定的个人问题。它不会替你生成结论，而是引导你完整地审视生活、形成自己的答案，并将其转化为切合实际的决定和行动。

此框架由 15 项相互关联的练习组成，帮助你了解真正重要的事、审视生活各方面的平衡、区分自己的愿望与外界期待、明确想要打造的未来、处理恐惧和障碍，并确定现实可行的下一步。

与开放式对话不同，DREAMHALL 设计成一个有明确起点、经过精心安排的顺序和有意义终点的完整流程。每个答案都由你书写，每个结论都属于你。最终生成一份个人文档，汇总你的思考、优先事项、决定和下一步行动。

你的私人回答会保留在 DREAMHALL 中，不会通过此集成返回给 ChatGPT。

完成后，你可以将个人文档保存在 DREAMHALL 中、下载为 PDF，或导出为 Markdown。之后如你愿意，可在 ChatGPT 中使用自己的文档来整理想法、制定计划、比较不同版本，或扩展成更长的文章。由你决定分享什么以及何时分享。

DREAMHALL 支持反思、自我平衡、个人身心健康和自主决策。这是一款非临床自我关怀产品，不属于治疗、诊断、医疗服务、紧急援助或危机支持。

有些最重要的决定，应该由你自己作出。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OathMCP helps users find, inspect, and run 39 established clinical calculators with explicit units, deterministic results, plausibility checks, limitations, and evidence links.

payload.name: Bella Noor Skin Concierge
payload.description: 挑选你的纽约面部护理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bella Noor Skin Concierge helps users choose skincare treatments in New York City based on skin goals, sensitivity, event timing, location, and treatment interest. payload.name: SmartSpectra
payload.description: 无需接触，用任意摄像头测量生命体征
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

开发者会在远程生命体征监测、远程医疗初诊、非接触式健康检查、员工健康筛查、驾驶员疲劳检测、临床试验筛查以及 iOS、Android 和网页端的数字生物标志物采集中使用 SmartSpectra rPPG。

使用此连接器获取 SDK 凭据和 API 密钥、检查套餐用量、管理已注册的移动应用、查找应用配置文件，并搜索 SmartSpectra rPPG 集成文档。

还可测量心率变异性（HRV）和皮肤电活动，目前正在开展非接触式血压测量相关工作。

SmartSpectra SDK 由 Presage Technologies 开发；该公司于 2026 年为其 SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0 的心率和呼吸频率测量获得 FDA 510(k) clearance（K254169）。Presage 总部位于 USA 弗吉尼亚州利斯堡，服务医疗保健、政府和健康福祉市场。

payload.name: Kenso
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

Kenso 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看当前训练、训练历史、恢复情况、营养、身体指标、训练计划和个人纪录。在用户确认且具备相应 OAuth 权限范围的情况下，它还可以在用户的 Kenso 账户中创建或调整私人训练计划、记录训练、暂存导入内容、完成训练课、丢弃暂存的导入内容，并保存持久教练偏好。

开始使用

输入 @ 并从菜单中选择 Kenso 来开始消息——这样才能在对话中调用 Kenso。若不这样做，ChatGPT 会根据自身记忆作答，而不会使用你的训练数据。

• @Kenso 显示我今天的训练
• @Kenso 我今天该练什么？
• @Kenso 记录我的训练：卧推 3x8，80kg；划船 3x10，60kg
• @Kenso 调出 Upper A 让我记录——它会显示一张卡片，供你逐组填写
• @Kenso 我的卧推趋势如何？
• @Kenso 我的胸部训练量够吗？

交互式卡片——训练记录卡片和图表分析——会在网页版 ChatGPT 中显示。移动端会以文本形式提供相同答案。

当 Kenso 确实正在使用时，你会在聊天中看到它。如果收到的答案没有 Kenso 参与，请说“check Kenso”。

图表分析——力量评分、肌肉训练量与训练基准对照、恢复详情，以及体能与疲劳情况——需要 Kenso Pro。
